notes.title: Build Update 20250724
notes.content:
Hey Pioneers!  

We’ve just rolled out a new patch packed with improvements, bug fixes, and fresh features based on your feedback. Thank you all for testing, reporting, and helping us shape Brave New Wonders! Here’s what’s new:

New Tech Tree Design: Major visual upgrade with new animations and bug fixes!

Added "Stop Production" button on manufacturers

Added Minimap when selecting destinations for automatons

Added enemy drone loot drops

Introduced new pinned resource design

New destination arrow for better visual clarity

Energy production and consumption rebalanced

Early game recipes rebalanced

Added a texture quality settings in graphics menu(more graphics settings to come!)

Fixed the unresponsive Blueprint button

Fixed Submit Feedback UI layout

Fixed frame rate drops in southern areas

And more!


Thanks again for all your support and bug reports. Keep the feedback coming—we're building this game together! 🛠️
👉 Don’t forget to submit feedback in-game and wishlist Brave New Wonders if you haven’t already!


Cheers,
Sala @ City From Naught

notes.title: Build Update 20250707
notes.content:
Thanks for all your support and feedback — we’ve been hard at work! Here’s what’s new in this build:

✨ Visual & UI Improvements

Updated overall UI for a cleaner and more immersive experience

Brand new character animations

Redesigned resource icons for better readability

New tutorial UI with more visual guides and image-based instructions

Added a mini map with clearer indicators, plus a new big map for better navigation

Added the Artificer

🤖 Gameplay & Features

Automaton settings now support pin/unpin for easier management

New construction site tutorial to guide you through building

Exit-to-main-menu now includes a confirmation popup to prevent accidental loss

Added pickup shortcuts for smoother resource collection

🐞 Bug Fixes & Performance

Fixed frame rate drops in certain scenes

Addressed save system bugs for more reliable saves and loads

Improved enemy drone animations for better clarity and impact

Redesigned several factory components for better visual feedback and function

And many more

We’ll continue improving based on your feedback. Keep sharing your thoughts — and thank you for being part of this journey!





Best,

Sala @ City From Naught

notes.title: Build Update 20250619
notes.content:
🚀 Brave New Wonders - Quality of Life & Content Update 🌞 2025/6/19

Here’s what’s new in our latest update:

🧠 Tech Tree Redesign – A cleaner, more intuitive progression system.

🎒 Bigger Backpack – Starting inventory increased from 10 to 20 slots.

🔧 Updated Toolbar – Slimmer design for better visibility during gameplay.

🪂 Improved Supply Drops – Now much easier to spot!

🛠️ Crash Fixes – Resolved an issue related to space bar usage.

🔒 Blueprint Mode Hidden Early On – To avoid overwhelming new players.

🤖 New Tutorial – Learn how to assign tasks to your automatons.

⚡ Dynamic Building Animations – Now react to power levels in real time.

❌ Close Buttons Added – All windows now have a proper exit icon.

🔁 View Switch Shortcut – Changed to Tab for quicker access.



Thanks for playing and stay tuned for more updates! 🏗️🌍
